title: Use a single reference image plus a long, detailed prompt to...
content:
Use a single reference image plus a long, detailed prompt to generate a full sequence in Seedance 2.0 (including transitions, sound effects, editing, and text) without additional editing  
Render the same Seedance sequence twice and pick the better ending from the alternate render in post
description: 99% of this came out of Seedance 2.0 without any altering or editing: transitions, sound effects, editing, text, etc. Input was one image for reference and a pretty long prompt. The only thing I've changed in post is that I've rendered the sequence twice and chose the ending from the other render. This model really puts the "intelligence" in the AI. I will deliberately not put comparisons of how much would have this cost, or how much time would this have been with traditional methods, but let's face it: content will change forever if this is the new baseline. #Seedance2
